SECTION 7 – Regulation FD Item 7.01 Regulation FD Disclosure. On November 6, 2026, Sylvamo Corporation (the “Company”) announced that it is entering into a put option agreement with Midas Atlantic Partners, in partnership with The Najafi Companies, for a binding offer to acquire the Company’s Europe business (the “Offer”). The Offer is for the business to be transferred to Midas Atlantic Partners with an agreed level of working capital and cash in exchange for the right to receive 20% of future distributions of the business. Before making any final decision concerning the Offer, the Company will conduct applicable consultation processes with works councils and employee representatives in accordance with local laws. Once consultation processes are complete, the parties expect to enter into a definitive share purchase agreement to transfer the business to Midas Atlantic Partners. Closing is expected by the end of the first quarter of 2027. The potential transaction is subject to various risks, uncertainties and other factors, as noted below under the heading “Forward-Looking Statements”. A copy of the Company’s press release announcing receipt of the binding offer is furnished pursuant to item 7.01 as Exhibit 99.1 Forward-Looking Statements This current report contains forward-looking statements within the meaning of Section 27A of the Securities Act of 1933 and Section 21E of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, including, without limitation, statements concerning consultation with works councils, entry into a share purchase agreement and transaction timing. Any or all forward-looking statements may turn out to be incorrect, and the Company’s actual actions and results could differ materially from what they express or imply, because they involve known and unknown risks, uncertainties and other factors, many of which are beyond the Company’s control. These risks, uncertainties, and other factors include, but are not limited to, the Company’s ability to successfully complete the proposed sale, including satisfying conditions related to works council approvals, obtaining regulatory approvals and meeting other conditions to closing, as well as the risks disclosed in the heading “Risk Factors” in our Annual Report on Form 10-K for the year ended December 31, 2025, filed with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (the “SEC”) and in our subsequent filings with the SEC, available on our website, Sylvamo.com. These forward-looking statements reflect our current expectations, and we undertake no obligation to publicly update any forward-looking statements, whether as a result of new information, future events or otherwise.
